title.zh: Meta launches enterprise AI platform, hires MongoDB CEO to lead new initiative
title.en: Meta launches enterprise AI platform, hires MongoDB CEO to lead new initiative

current_state.zh: Meta announced an enterprise AI platform that packages its full technology stack, including Muse, Meta Business Agent, Muse API and Muse Code, for businesses and developers, and hired MongoDB's CEO to lead the new initiative.
current_state.en: Meta announced an enterprise AI platform that packages its full technology stack, including Muse, Meta Business Agent, Muse API and Muse Code, for businesses and developers, and hired MongoDB's CEO to lead the new initiative.
